title: Valid Brackets
description:
## Task

Decide whether the brackets in a string are balanced: every opening bracket is closed by the same kind of bracket, and pairs are properly nested.

## Input

- `s` — a string made only of the characters `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{` and `}`. It may be empty.

## Output

A boolean: `True` if the brackets are balanced, otherwise `False`. The empty string is balanced.

## Example

```python
is_balanced("[{}]()")  # returns True
is_balanced("{(})")  # returns False
is_balanced("((")  # returns False
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `s` ≤ 10^4
